messages:
alisha: Quick thread 5252 we have inconsistent behavior across runtimes when a request's payload doesn't match the model signature (wrong schema for structured outputs / missing required function args). Some runtimes return 400, others return 409, and a few return a 422 with vague text. We need a canonical API contract and console UX. Thoughts?

ben: We should avoid 400 for this. 400 is too generic and conflates network/form issues with semantic incompatibility. 422 (Unprocessable Entity) maps well to 'payload syntactically OK but semantically wrong'. 409 (Conflict) feels odd.

maria: I lean 422 too, but product will want a consistent error code consumers can program against. Propose: HTTP 422 + error.code = MODEL_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH. Include structured details so SDKs can surface field-level problems.

serena: Agree on 422. Also add a header for backwards compatibility: `X-Redwood-Error-Type: schema` so older clients that only inspect headers can still react.

product-bot: note: product prefers messages that suggest immediate remediation steps. Eg: "update call signature" or linking to route settings.

alisha: Sample payload proposal (SDK-first):
```
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json
X-Redwood-Error-Type: model-signature

{
  "error": {
    "code": "MODEL_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH",
    "message": "Provided function args don't match model 'gptx-func' signature",
    "retryable": false,
    "details": [
      { "path": "args.user_id", "expected": "string", "received": "integer", "hint": "cast to string" },
      { "path": "tools[0].name", "expected": "oneOf:['search','lookup']", "received": "'unknown'", "hint": "choose supported tool" }
    ]
  }
}
```

ben: Love the `details` array. SDKs should transform that into typed exceptions and field-level helpers. Also include `spec_version` in header/body so we can evolve the error schema.

maria: Telemetry requirements: add `error.type = model_signature`, `error.signature_mismatch.count`, and `error.signature_mismatch.field_errors` as a histogramable tag. That will let us alert when a new client rollout causes a spike.

serena: Console UX: in the request inspector show a new "Signature errors" panel with per-field hints and suggested fix buttons, e.g., "convert int -> string" or "map tool name". Clicking a suggestion shows example payload. Also show an alert on route if > 5 signature errors/min over 5m.

alisha: On retry semantics: never retry by default. retryable=false. If this is a transient parsing bug caused by a known runtime bug, then the runtime can return `retryable: true` and optionally `Retry-After`. But default is false.

ben: Edge-case: function-calling mismatch where tools are missing should be a separate subtype: `FUNCTION_ARG_MISMATCH` since remediation steps differ. Could be 422 as well but distinct code.

maria: Good call. Also add `error.meta.route_guidance = "pin-to-stable"|"update-client"` so console can surface targeted CTAs.

product-bot: Product note recorded: microcopy should avoid developer-blaming language. Example recommended line: "The request payload doesn't match the model's expected signature. Suggested fixes: ..." and link to docs.

serena: Implementation plan: runtime change to standardize 422 + headers, SDK changes to parse `details`, telemetry schema updated, console panel mock. I'll own runtime PR.

ben: I'll update SDK error types and add migration guide.

maria: I'll update metrics + alerting and produce Grafana mock.

alisha: Product will draft the console microcopy and the docs page with examples.

serena: One more: versioning. We'll stamp `X-Redwood-Error-Schema: v1` in both header and body. Future breaking changes require bumping schema version.

alisha: Action items summed: standardize on 422+MODEL_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH, header `X-Redwood-Error-Type`, body details array, telemetry fields, console "Signature errors" panel, SDK typed exceptions, product copy + docs. Thanks folks, let's review PRs next week. :white_check_mark:
